Writes a line to the server log for each item and passes the items on. The run's Output tab shows them too.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `output.log` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Message (`message`) | text | no | `Workflow item` | {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}}. |
